notes.title: Russian Mailman Simulator now FREE!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has supported Russian Mailman Simulator since release! As the developer I feel this project has gone as far as it will, so I have to decided to reduce the cost to free. Thanks so much for everyone who tested the game, and provided feedback, you were all so very helpful.
-Acorn

notes.title: Aiming Patch
notes.notes: Some aiming down sights issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Russian Mailman Simulator is Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted, or even purchased Russian Mailman Simulator so far. What started as a joke idea between a few discord buddies has turned into a full blown game. I am so excited to see where it will go.

Thanks to everyone who has supported me so far in the journey, you guys have been a great help!

See you in the next update.
-Me
